# AIX Core

Experimental semantic interoperability specification for agent task and context exchange.

## Entry points
- README.md: scope and limitations
- docs/SPECIFICATION.md: normative-intent core semantics
- docs/MAPPING-GUIDE.md: standards-extension and mapping principles
- docs/THREAT_MODEL.md: security boundary
- manifest.json: component manifest
- capabilities.json: declared capabilities
- compatibility.json: versioning policy
- schemas/aix-message.schema.json: experimental envelope
- tools/validate_message.py: schema validator

## Important
AIX extends existing standards; it does not replace them. Schema validation does not authenticate or authorize a sender. No private model reasoning is part of the contract.
